subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK adopt 16 MiB and 30 seconds as its fixed request-body transport limits?
rationale: The hardening is technically sound, but choosing these values changes previously unbounded accepted behavior and requires knowledge of legitimate Copilot SDK payload sizes that the repository does not currently document.

options.title: Confirm and land these limits
options.body: Accept 16 MiB and 30 seconds after representative large-context and media-bearing BYOK requests are shown to remain below the boundary.

options.title: Raise the fixed ceiling
options.body: Select a larger bounded ceiling based on observed Copilot SDK payloads while retaining deterministic 413 and timeout handling.

options.title: Pause for SDK envelope data
options.body: Hold the PR until Copilot SDK maintainers or live traces establish a defensible maximum request size and duration.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land these limits
recommendation.body: Accept 16 MiB and 30 seconds after representative large-context and media-bearing BYOK requests are shown to remain below the boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Copilot harness lifecycle work makes this the strongest available owner for the BYOK transport contract.
